title: glosa release manifest
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.4 (release state machine + PUB-ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW's seven dimensions R1-R7) and the mandatory Blackbox Note appendix precondition on every genre's Publish node (§6.4). Read by the Project Advisor's `advise()` precondition check (templates/knowledge/advisor_prompt_packet.md step 1: 'Confirm gate_verdict is PASS or PASS_WITH_LIMITS'). Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

adversarial_review.description: PUB-ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW, seven dimensions (§7.4) -- run by an independent pass, never the maker.

approver_kind.description: MUST-7 (ARCH_integrity.md F1 / kernel/glosa_kernel.py's _human_approver_error_for_manifest): names whether the approver_id above is a human or an AI identity. Required, and must be 'human', once status reaches Approved-for-Live, k_state_declared reaches K2/K3, or mc_level reaches L5 -- an AI identity never satisfies the Approver role at these gates (FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.1; AGENTS.md rule 5, 'AI is never an author').

blackbox_note_appendix_present.description: Hard precondition on every genre's Publish node (§6.4) -- a release with this false must not reach Approved-for-Live.

human_mastery_gate_ref.description: methodology/P10_publish_gate.md R8 (HU-1, hu.mastery-gate-wired, design/SESSION_ARCH_v0.4_SPEC.md §11.1): points at a schema/human_mastery_gate.schema.json instance's gate_id. Additive/optional; absence is a WARNING (kernel gate_release), not a hard schema fail -- pending founder ratification of R8's exact enforcement strength (P17 'founder_decision_needed: true'). An arXiv-paper-genre artifact using the inline Gate status: line may leave this null and satisfy R8 by that route instead.

allOf.description: The mandatory Blackbox Note appendix precondition (§2.4, §6.4): a manifest may not reach Approved-for-Live without it.
gate_verdict FAIL cannot coexist with an Approved-for-Live/Approved-for-Test status.

MUST-7: status Approved-for-Live, k_state_declared K2/K3, or independent_check_summary.mc_level L5 requires a human Approver -- independent_check_summary.approver_kind must be 'human', not merely present.
